steps.condition: UnitLevel('player')==1 and UnitXP('player')==0 and UnitXPMax('player')==400 and MainMenuExpBar:IsVisible() and MainMenuExpBar:GetValue()==0 and select(2,MainMenuExpBar:GetMinMaxValues())==400

(function() local state,_,factor=GetRestState(); local r,g,b=MainMenuExpBar:GetStatusBarColor(); return state==2 and factor==1 and GetXPExhaustion()==nil and math.abs(r-0.58)<0.001 and g==0 and math.abs(b-0.55)<0.001 end)()

steps.code: QuestXPWatch=CreateFrame('Frame'); QuestXPWatch.xp=0; QuestXPWatch.title=0; QuestXPWatch.award=0; QuestXPWatch:RegisterEvent('PLAYER_XP_UPDATE'); QuestXPWatch:RegisterEvent('CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM'); QuestXPWatch:SetScript('OnEvent',function(self,event,arg) if event=='PLAYER_XP_UPDATE' and arg=='player' and UnitXP('player')==40 then self.xp=self.xp+1 elseif event=='CHAT_MSG_SYSTEM' then if arg==string.format(ERR_QUEST_COMPLETE_S,'A Threat Within') then self.title=self.title+1 elseif arg==string.format(ERR_QUEST_REWARD_EXP_I,40) then self.award=self.award+1 end end end)

steps.condition: UnitLevel('player')==1 and UnitXP('player')==40 and UnitXPMax('player')==400 and QuestXPWatch.xp==1 and QuestXPWatch.award==1 and QuestXPWatch.title==1
